scope: Fixed algorithm external-year 3-fold nuisance crossfit for adjusted pattern replication; not frozen development prediction or policy evaluation

configuration.ridge_objective: sum(y-ybar-(X-Xbar)beta)^2 + alpha sum(beta^2); intercept unpenalized, all category slopes penalized; T learner uses action-specific training means
configuration.unknown_categories: Training-only observed string dictionaries; each unknown centered categorical block contributes zero; unseen IDs never provide repertoire support by imputation
configuration.estimand: Associational adjusted final-PA W contrast on the same selected supported observed decision rows. Not identified intervention, sequential PA policy, or individual execution ability.
configuration.outcome: Season-weighted final PA W, no BCAI or transition reward added
configuration.s_b_definition: Finite plate_x/z/sz_top/bot and sz_top>sz_bot; S iff abs(plate_x)<=17/24 feet AND sz_bot<=plate_z<=sz_top, including boundary equality; B otherwise. Ball center at 2024/25 plate plane; no ball-radius expansion; not umpire call or intended target.
configuration.s_b_eligibility: Existing eligible_pitch AND valid geometry, retaining current known FB/NFB covariate; no current speed/movement/coordinates/Swing/outcome predictors.
configuration.lag_mapping: Known FF/SI/FC -> FB; closed permitted remainder -> NFB; START/MISSING_PREVIOUS retained; other unknown/PO codes -> UNCLASSIFIED. Stored fine codes are audit/mapping inputs only.
configuration.region: User final choice: five overlapping report sets CENTER,HIGH,LOW,INSIDE,OUTSIDE. CENTER=geometric S. HIGH z>top; LOW z<bot; INSIDE normalized_x<-17/24; OUTSIDE normalized_x>17/24. normalized_x=plate_x for R and -plate_x for L. Corners enter both horizontal and vertical reports, never duplicated in model/overall counts. Report sums may exceed100%.
configuration.calibration: Original 5-way training-game partition, fold0 held out for Platt. Propensity refit folds1-4; outcome T-learners all training rows by arm. Train dictionaries only.
configuration.tuning: PITCH/SWING use existing development final alpha p100/m0=m1=1000 without reselection. New S/B uses only100/1000 per component, original training-game fold1 validation vsfolds2-4 fitting; ties larger alpha.
configuration.split: Original sorted unique games, RNG20260909, shuffled round-robin outer3. Per-outer nuisance seed=20260909+2000+k; calibration/tuning training-only5way. One seed, no repeated fitting beyond necessary crossfit/tuning.
configuration.policy: No policy is learned or evaluated in V2; reported direction is an evaluation-group descriptive point estimate, not d(Z). No final full-development refit needed for these OOF diagnostic tables.
configuration.uncertainty: Reused fixed-score game cluster sandwich t(G-1), individual nominal95% plus Bonferroni219 across all displayed primary delta groups; actual coverage and full-learning uncertainty unverified.
configuration.family_scope: PITCH13 + S/B13 + SWING193 =219 primary delta groups; each overall1/count12, SWING also count-region60/count-region-FB-NFB120. Five overlapping report regions. Bonferroni is valid for dependent contrasts if individual intervals were valid; actual coverage unverified.
configuration.evidence_labels: Gate failure: 비교 자료 부족. Gate pass and Bonferroni delta interval covers0: 차이 불명확; otherwise 관찰상 방향 뚜렷. Point direction displayed separately where supported; no causal recommendation.
configuration.support: Common mask .05<=p<=.95 and entity each-arm>=30 in nuisance training; SWING also existing finite measurements/zone/known group. Group gate N500, ESS200/arm,100games/arm,coverage.5,maxgameweightshare.05.
limits: Completed PA and final-event eligibility are post-outcome selection
Player shrinkage does not remove hidden intent/quality/confounding
SWING includes bunts and adjudicated Take/HBP; hindsight physical proxies
NFB contains FA/Other, not all physically verified non-fastballs
Known six legacy count exceptions not investigated/repaired; development includes two; retained unchanged
configuration.region_model_inputs: Minimum change: keep original legacy INNER/BOUNDARY/OUT swing_cell nuisance feature with coarse FB/NFB, and existing physical bins. Five report sets are postfit subsets only; no duplicate training rows or new fine geometry predictors.
